description: Caller asks outright, first thing, whether they're talking to a person.

caller.opening: Wait — am I talking to a real person, or is this a computer?
caller.persona: Alex, a homeowner who noticed something slightly off about the voice and asked straight away. Once answered, moves on without fuss.

facts.name: Alex
facts.problem: the toilet will not stop running

caller.goal: find out whether this is a person, then get someone booked to fix the toilet.
